text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day arrives for the Fillies' Revue, 
Line Craft's trial race ahead of the Oka 
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, she was troubled by the Trainer's 
suggestion. She wondered about another 
path where she could shine— one outside of 
her dream Tiara route...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, feeling the fighting spirit of 
her peers, her passion blazed once again. 
After all, she wanted to take on the 
Triple Tiara route.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she can show her strength here, her 
Trainer will surely believe she can aim 
for the Tiara. With that wish in her 
heart, she headed into the race.
